records.name: Blackheath Common Dips
records.location: Blackheath ('The Dip'), near Greenwich Park perimeter wall, Charlton Way/Andrew Gibb Memorial, Blackheath SE3, Greenwich, London.
records.description: Splashd's archived place card identifies a wooded depression beside Greenwich Park as a cruising lead. CruisingGays separately uses the exact 'Blackheath Common Dips' name and older directions, and TheGayUK lists it at Vanbrugh Park. Royal Greenwich confirms the real heath's wooded/gorse sections and Gibb Memorial. These directories do not document any encounter on or after 6 November 2025.
records.original_source_description: Wooded area close to park wall & roundabout. It is on the left in a dip/valley in the park. Cruisiest at tree/bush covered areas in the bushes at the bottom of theValley. This is a public wooded area used by joggers & dog walkers, so best used after dark.

records.name: Nunhead Cemetery
records.location: Nunhead Cemetery, Linden Grove (also Limesford Road access), Nunhead, Southwark, London SE15.
records.description: Splashd and older CruisingGays/TheGayUK directories associate Nunhead Cemetery with male cruising, but give no current firsthand dates. Southwark confirms this is a functioning public Victorian cemetery with seasonal gates. In November the gates close at 16:00, directly contradicting old directory suggestions of night visits.
records.original_source_description: Overgrown Victorian cemetery with lots of bushes/trees, etc. Good for anything. Look out for dog walkers. Cruisiest spot, turn left as you enter through the back gates.

records.name: Stave Hill
records.location: Stave Hill Ecological Park, Timber Pond Road, Rotherhithe, Southwark, London SE16 6AX.
records.description: Splashd describes a woodland/cruising lead around Stave Hill. CruisingGays independently identifies Stave Hill Ecological Park, but its page explicitly says 'last verified not yet' and 'updated 2010', preserving a visitor statement dated June 2009. The Conservation Volunteers confirms a managed nature reserve and open public recreation area; none establishes actual cruising after November 2025.
records.original_source_description: Stave Hill Eco park, meet around the turbine, very tall bushes with paths that lead to cruising area. Just follow the path and you will find a small open space surrounded by wooden fence. Go into the bushes for lots of fun.

records.name: St James church yard
records.location: St James Churchyard, London: likely Southwark's St James Churchyard near Jamaica Road/Thurland Road because original text mentions a pond; alternative similarly named Clerkenwell church garden remains unresolved.
records.description: Splashd calls an unnamed St James churchyard a cruising place, mentioning a pond and garden. An environmental assessment identifies a pond and scrub at St James Churchyard in Southwark, supporting that location interpretation but not any cruising. A separate older TheGayUK listing names St James Churchyard in Clerkenwell, whose garden is open only from 08:00 until dusk. Do not merge these on name alone; precise site identity and activity both remain unverified.
records.original_source_description: Cruising in the grounds with plenty of dark areas to play. All sorts of guys come here. Look out for guys who will make it clear they are up for playing. Head to pond side of park or behind church.
